content.text: {"abstained":false,"abstention_reason":"","answer":"The Gram Panchayat (GP) plays a central role in MGNREGA registration [E03]. It verifies that the household is a legitimate entity, that applicants are local residents, and that they are adult members [E03]. The GP must complete verification within a fortnight of receiving the application [E03]. Once a household is found eligible, the GP issues a Job Card within a fortnight, which is handed over to a household member in the presence of other GP residents [E03]. The Panchayat Secretary or Gram Rozgar Sahayak also enters all eligible household particulars into the MIS (NREGASoft) system [E03]. Additionally, registrations are opened throughout the year at the GP office [E01].","cited_evidence_ids":["E01","E03"],"claim_to_evidence":[{"claim":"The GP verifies household eligibility including whether the household is a legitimate entity, applicants are local residents, and are adult members","evidence_ids":["E03"]},{"claim":"The GP must complete verification within a fortnight of receiving the application","evidence_ids":["E03"]},{"claim":"The GP issues a Job Card to eligible households within a fortnight","evidence_ids":["E03"]},{"claim":"The Panchayat Secretary or Gram Rozgar Sahayak enters eligible household particulars into the MIS system","evidence_ids":["E03"]},{"claim":"Registrations are opened throughout the year at the GP office","evidence_ids":["E01"]}]}
